Also the tournaments and the fact that players have been traveling a lot and the coach started to become also a coach as a traveling figure with the tennis player. What happened that was clear that when you are away from your club for one month, sometimes two months because at that time there was satellite tournaments, so the necessity to have also somebody to take care of the fitness and most of the time also all the things around the fitness so it was very pushing a lot. Basically I stopped to do track and field because I had, I broke my knee. That was basically so from day one to day two, I finished my career. In one way, this was kind of a shot to luck because then suddenly I had a lot of time and to go around to travel and that's exactly what happened.
